channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: New Longford GAA Centre of Excellence will be open to other sports
item.description: Longford GAA will be making its proposed Centre of Excellence available to other sports.

item.title: 'I don't see him making wholesale changes'
item.description: Seán Óg Ó hAilpín doesn't foresee new Cork hurling manager Ben O'Connor making too many changes to the set-up.

item.title: Munster GAA keen to see minor restored to U18
item.description: Munster Council chairman Tim Murphy is hopeful the minor grade will be restored to U18 at inter-county level.

item.title: Louth and Down face off on New Year's Eve
item.description: The Louth and Down senior footballers will meet in the annual Jim McGeough Cup at the Geraldines GAA grounds on New Year's Eve.

item.title: Kennedy signs for Lions
item.description: Tipperary ladies football star Caitlin Kennedy has signed a rookie contract with the Brisbane Lions.

item.title: Lavery takes charge of Galbally
item.description: Galbally have signalled their 2026 Tyrone SFC ambitions with the appointment of Ruairí Lavery as their new manager.

item.title: O'Riordan appointed Sydney Swans AFLW coach
item.description: Colin O'Riordan has made history by becoming the first Irish senior coach in the AFLW.

item.title: McAleese: 2027 merger on track
item.description: Mary McAleese says the 2027 date for the merger of the GAA, LGFA and Camogie Association remains a 'realistic target', despite 'pockets of resistance'.

item.title: Watch: umpires clash as controversial calls overshadow colleges classic
item.description: The umpires were the centre of attention in yesterday's Br Bosco Cup (Leinster Colleges Senior 'A' Football Championship) quarter-final between Marist College, Athlone and Terenure College.

item.title: 'High performance licence' mooted to curb inter-county spending
item.description: GAA president Jarlath Burns has revealed that a 'high performance licence' is in the works to control spending on inter-county teams.
